primary_unique_math_proof: Write each small rectangle sides l>s. In the lower block, two vertical long sides span the same height as three stacked short sides:2l=3s.
PQ=s+2l=4s. QR=3l=9s/2 (also three short widths plus one long width). Therefore PQ:QR=8:9, uniquely E.
